text:
Sam (PM): Starting a thread to lock down the private-preview design partner plan. Key ask: recruit 8	6 customers to validate Dedicated rollout policies, autoscale, and fallback routing. Thoughts on cohort mix and landing criteria?
Priya (Recruiting): 8 engaged customers is doable. Recommend 10 invites (expect ~20% drop). Mix: 4 startups, 3 mid-market product teams, 1 regulated (health/finance).
Diego (Eng): We need to validate: 1) routing policy fallback (latency -> cheaper model), 2) autoscale behavior under burst, 3) KV cache warmup effects. For tests we should onboard pairs of customers with high/low QPS.
Maya (Research): Success signals: onboarding completion time, infra incidents per-customer, routing delta (latency vs cost), and qualitative satisfaction. Suggest primary success metric = onboarding completion <= 4 days for 75% of cohort.
Leo (Design): Onboarding kit: preconfigured config repo, a 30-min walkthrough, a checklist with 7 items (credentials, routes, sample traffic, eval set, alerts, backup plan, consent). Keep the kit as a short PR.
Priya (Recruiting): Screening snippet for form: 
```
Company size: [1-50 / 51-250 / 251-1000 / 1000+]
Primary workload: [chat / embeddings / search / rerank / other]
Estimated peak qps: [<10 / 10-100 / >100]
Compliance needs: [none / SOC2 / HIPAA / other]
Can commit to weekly 30-min syncs + traffic tests? [yes/no]
Provide 2 sample queries/prompts (paste)
```
Maya (Research): Add: which cloud region they'd prefer and whether they need VPC or on-prem. Also consent checkbox for debug telemetry.
Sam (PM): Launch gates (must have all): security checklist signed, eval set uploaded, at least one smoke route active, and a monitoring dashboard instantiated. If missing, move to waitlist.
Diego (Eng): Define "onboarding completion": from acceptance -> first successful smoke-run that exercises routing and autoscale policy. We'll mark success when p95 latency < target and no errors.
Leo (Design): Feedback cadence: weekly short pulse (3 quick questions) + a final in-depth interview. Keep weekly pulse: usability, performance, blockers.
Priya (Recruiting): Incentives: $1.5k credits + prioritized support + post-pilot pilot write-up collaboration. Also allow an NDA if needed.
Maya (Research): Metric weighting idea: 50% onboarding completion, 30% reliability (incidents), 20% qualitative sentiment. Agree?
Diego (Eng): agree
Sam (PM): agree. We'll document weights in the scoring sheet.
oncall-bot: Note: please add calendar event for onboarding slots.
Priya (Recruiting): Timeline: outreach Mon Apr 18, screening calls Apr 20	6, rolling onboard Apr 25	6May 6, active pilot May 9	6Jun 20. That gives 6 weeks of active testing.
Diego (Eng): Capacity note: stagger start dates by customer to allow infra tuning. Also want two customers to run stress tests in week 2.
Leo (Design): I'll produce the onboarding checklist PR and two interview scripts (integration health + routing UX).
Maya (Research): I'll create the pulse survey and final interview guide; will keep interview <=30min.
Sam (PM): Action items: Priya build Typeform + shortlist; Diego write rollout playbook and autoscale test plan; Leo write checklist; Maya write surveys. We'll reconvene Thu 10am to review shortlist.
Priya (Recruiting): Will target customers with existing infra teams to reduce hand-holding. Posting shortlist here when ready.
Diego (Eng): I'll add telemetry tags to track per-route cost and fallback count. Will link infra doc here once ready.
Sam (PM): Any immediate blockers? Call them out now so we can shift timeline.
Priya (Recruiting): No blockers on my side.
Diego (Eng): Need one infra dependency updated (kernel op for quantized variant). If that slips, we may delay stress tests by ~1 week.
Maya (Research): Ok noted. We'll keep interviews flexible.
Sam (PM): Cool. Locking this plan for now. Please dump any templates or prior pilot notes into the shared folder. We'll iterate on shortlist Thu.
